The quickest trains for Sun 25 Oct leave in the early morning and take 1 hr 40 min to 1 hr 50 min:

Vande Bharat 22470: Hazrat Nizamuddin 6:00 AM to Agra Cantt 7:40 AM (1 hr 40 min), chair car and executive chair.
Gatimaan Express 12050: Hazrat Nizamuddin 8:10 AM to Agra Cantt 9:50 AM (1 hr 40 min), chair car and executive chair.
Shatabdi 12002: New Delhi 6:00 AM to Agra Cantt 7:50 AM (1 hr 50 min), chair car and executive chair. This is the quickest one that leaves from New Delhi itself.
Taj Express 12280: New Delhi 6:55 AM to Agra Cantt 9:25 AM (2 hr 30 min), chair car and second sitting, so likely the cheaper choice.
Punjab Mail 12138: New Delhi 5:10 AM to Agra Cantt 8:10 AM (3 hr), with sleeper and AC classes.

The Vande Bharat and Gatimaan leave from Hazrat Nizamuddin, not New Delhi. The page showed only trains up to about 11:25 AM, so later ones are not covered. It also did not confirm which of these run on Sunday, and I found no fares. IRCTC blocked access, so I did not use it.
